newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc again ends lower, but above lows.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc again ends lower, but above lows.

text.p: 1600 GMT - The Swiss franc again ended lower against the dollar, but above lows as it took a slight pause after slipping through 1.43 earlier today.
Dealers said the market was still bullish on the dollar with yesterday's comments by U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's on the strength of the U.S. economy confirming the market's view.
Dealers are puzzled about the franc's next move, but said they would not be surprised to see it drop toward 1.45 soon.
